text: Every team has more questions than hours.
Netigen turns them into finished work.
One platform. Four layers. Naper, Nexus, Neuron, and Nimbus.
In Naper, admins decide who gets which agents, apps and models, with seats and spend limits built in.
In Nexus, your team asks in plain words.
It searches the live web, and cites its sources.
Turns the answer into a slide deck.
And runs it again, on schedule.
Neuron answers from your business: your knowledge, your data, your agents.
Nimbus shows what every answer cost, how fast it came back, and how people rated it.
Govern it. Use it. Ground it. See it.
Netigen. One AI platform, for every stage of business.
